mapper.sql: emp12_event_id AS event_id, emp12_person_id AS person_id, TO_CHAR(emp12_event_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS event_dt, emp12_event_nm AS event_nm, emp12_event_part AS event_part, emp12_event_desc AS event_desc, emp12_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM emp12_event JOIN emp01_person ON emp12_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp12_event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp12_event ( emp12_event_id, emp12_person_id, emp12_event_dt , emp12_event_nm, emp12_event_part, emp12_event_desc, emp12_note ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{req.personId}, #{req.eventDt}::date , #{req.eventNm}, #{req.eventPart}, #{req.eventDesc}, #{req.note} )
